newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Five dead in floods in northern Honduras.
newsitem.headline: Five dead in floods in northern Honduras.

text.p: Five people were killed in floods that washed away houses and roads in northern Honduras last week, officials said on Monday.
Colonel Luis Velasquez, president of the Regional Emergency Commission, said floodwaters dragged about 15 houses from their foundations and submerged others.
Honduras has been battered for 10 days by a tropical storm that damaged about 30 percent of its freeways, officials said.
